metadata.title: [FIX][API]: Server-scoped metrics recording across prompt, resource and tool services (#3237)
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
close #3237 
This pull request introduces enhanced metrics recording for server-specific operations across prompt, resource, and tool services. The main focus is to ensure that when operations are invoked through a virtual server endpoint (i.e., when a `server_id` is provided), both resource and prompt metrics, as well as server-specific metrics, are accurately recorded. Additionally, several refactorings improve logger configuration and code clarity.

**Metrics and Server-Specific Recording Enhancements:**

* Prompt Service:
  - Added initialization and usage of `metrics_buffer` at the module level for prompt operations. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1d2d5a09951d64f6a81a8993771cd9bc7febbc0639d949084d0ac08c25fc8218R47) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-1d2d5a09951d64f6a81a8993771cd9bc7febbc0639d949084d0ac08c25fc8218L111-R115)
  - Now records server metrics (via `metrics_buffer.record_server_metric`) when a prompt is accessed through a specific virtual server (when `server_id` is provided).
  - Refactored metrics recording to use the shared `metrics_buffer` instead of importing it inside functions.

* Resource Service:
  - Added `server_id` as an argument to `invoke_resource`, `read_resource`, and `list_resource_templates` to support server-scoped operations and metrics. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R1414) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R2324-R2330) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R3551)
  - Metrics for resources are now recorded in a single place (`read_resource`'s `finally` block), avoiding duplication and providing a single source of truth. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126L1921-R1929) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R2384-L2390)
  - Server metrics are now recorded when a resource is accessed through a specific virtual server, and detailed debug logging was added for visibility.
  - `list_resource_templates` now supports filtering by `server_id`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R3564) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R3585-R3588)
  - Module-level initialization of `metrics_buffer` for resource operations. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126R64) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-08c62d9c35cc87df6623a1d5e8bfdcf5fb3a514c172ad3399adce07f7215c126L109-R113)

* Tool Service:
  - Added module-level initialization of `metrics_buffer` for tool operations. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6dd24b32c559bf26f0b87904fd6f07c2b70e3044d8367915b20a4fb3938ce296R77) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-6dd24b32c559bf26f0b87904fd6f07c2b70e3044d8367915b20a4fb3938ce296L137-R142)
  - Improved logging for tool invocations to include `server_id`.
  - Clarified `server_id` usage in global context creation for tool invocations.

**Logging Improvements:**

* Logging Service:
  - Changed logger initialization to let child loggers inherit the root logger's level, ensuring that the environment variable `LOG_LEVEL` is always respected.
  - When setting the log level, the root logger is now updated so that new child loggers inherit the correct level.

**Other Notable Changes:**

* Passed `server_id` through to tool execution in `main.py` to support server-scoped metrics and logic.

These changes collectively improve observability, metrics accuracy, and maintainability, especially in environments with multiple virtual servers and endpoints.

reviews.author: TS0713
reviews.body:
Have tested this PR - works as expected, no issues. 
Tested by creating virtual server (based out of mcp server which has tools, resources, prompts added to gateway)
Added virtual server to mcp inspector (client) and invoked tools, resources (both resources & resource templates), prompts. 
Each of these calls are captured under server metrics and can be seen on gateway UI with server id (virtual server). Approved.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Approved after rebase, code review, LLMcross-review, and end-to-end verification on live deployment. All identified issues have been fixed.

commits.message:
fix(metrics): add server-scoped metrics recording across prompt, resource, and tool services

When operations are invoked through a virtual server endpoint (server_id
provided), both entity-specific metrics and server-level metrics are now
recorded. Direct /rpc calls without a server context do not populate
server metrics, maintaining clean separation.

Changes:
- Move metrics_buffer initialization to module level in prompt, resource,
  and tool services (consistent singleton pattern)
- Add server_id parameter to invoke_resource, read_resource, and
  list_resource_templates for server-scoped operations
- Record server metrics via metrics_buffer.record_server_metric when
  server_id is present in all three services
- Fix variable shadowing in tool_service GlobalContext creation
  (server_id -> context_server_id)
- Consolidate resource metrics recording in read_resource finally block
  (single source of truth, eliminates duplication from invoke_resource)
- Fix observability span leak in invoke_resource (span now closes
  regardless of resource_text value)
- Thread server_id through streamablehttp_transport list_resource_templates
- Let child loggers inherit root logger level instead of explicit set
- Update root logger in set_level for consistent level propagation

Closes #3237

Signed-off-by: Rakhi Dutta <rakhibiswas@yahoo.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(metrics): isolate server metrics flush and fix handler levels

Address issues identified during code review:

- Flush server metrics in a separate transaction so that an invalid
  server_id (FK violation from untrusted X-Server-ID header in admin
  API paths) does not roll back tool/resource/prompt/a2a metrics
- Update handler levels in LoggingService.set_level() so that changing
  the log level at runtime actually takes effect on console/file/storage
  handlers (previously only loggers were updated, handlers stayed pinned)
- Remove ineffective `# noqa: vulture` annotation (vulture ignores it)
- Fix prompt_service test patches to target module-level metrics_buffer
  instead of the now-unused factory function
- Add server_id assertions to streamable HTTP transport tests
- Remove noisy else-branch debug log and redundant condition check
- Merge duplicate logger.info calls and remove DEBUG-prefixed INFO log

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(metrics): validate server_id before recording and fix test state leaks

Root cause fix for server-scoped metrics: add `server_scoped` flag in
prompt_service and resource_service that is only set True after the
server association check passes. Server metrics are now recorded only
when server_id has been validated against the DB, preventing invalid
server_ids from untrusted admin API headers (X-Server-ID) or RPC params
from reaching the metrics buffer.

Fix test state leaks caused by set_level() now updating root logger and
handler levels globally:
- Add autouse fixtures in test_logging_service.py and
  test_logging_service_comprehensive.py to save/restore root logger and
  handler levels after each test
- This prevents set_level(ERROR) from poisoning caplog in downstream
  tests (test_multi_auth_headers, test_observability_service)

Fix test_flush_to_db_writes_all_metric_types to track both DB sessions
(main batch + server metrics) instead of overwriting a single holder.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
